rows.grounds: ṣaṭkarmma = six+action; compound of ṣaṣ (six) + karman (action/rite), nominative singular neuter subject
martyasya = of-mortal; genitive singular masculine of martya (mortal)
manorārādhanaṃ = mantra+worship; compound of mantra + ārādhana (worship), accusative singular neuter governed by vinā
vinā = without; indeclinable preposition/postposition governing the accusative
